connect.title: Connection retry
connect.trigger: Can't connect or no 200 yet: network-level errors such as connection reset, read/write timeout, DNS failure, plus HTTP 408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504.
connect.skips: Other status codes (400 / 401 / 403 / 404 / 413 / 422, etc.) are deterministic rejections; resending fails the same way, so they are raised immediately.
connect.desc: Resends the same request as-is. Once the stream has started (200 received), a mid-stream disconnect is not handled by this layer.

empty.title: Empty-response retry
empty.trigger: HTTP 200 with a normal stop finish_reason, but the whole response has no content block. Gateway empty frames, dropped reasoning fields and sampling hiccups all look like this.
empty.skips: Responses empty because max_tokens truncated them don't count (fix that by raising the output limit; resending would hit the same limit).
empty.desc: Resends the entire prompt, so it is costly on long contexts; keep the count modest.
empty.offHint: -1 = pass the empty response through as-is

stream.title: Same-provider safe-window retry
stream.where: This project · before any output is delivered
stream.trigger: Problems after the stream was established (200 received): connection dropped mid-stream, provider overloaded, 429 / 5xx error events inside the stream, and not a single token has reached the caller yet.
stream.skips: Quota exhausted (402 / insufficient_quota, handled by profile rotation), context too long (413 / context length, handled by compaction), and deterministic 400 / 401 / 403 / 404 / 422 rejections are never retried.
stream.desc: Replays the same request on the same profile. Since no output has been delivered yet, the replay can't duplicate model output or tool execution.
stream.offHint: -1 = on stream drop, hand off directly to the outer intent re-run

breaker.title: Polling circuit breaker
breaker.where: This project · process-wide, one shared instance
breaker.trigger: Trips once transient failures (429, 5xx, network errors) accumulate to the threshold. Deterministic failures (402 out of balance, 401 / 403 invalid key, 404 model not found) ignore the threshold and trip on the first occurrence.
breaker.skips: A single success resets the count, so a profile that occasionally glitches never slowly accumulates to a trip.
breaker.desc: After tripping, the profile enters cooldown, and polling skips it during cooldown. State is saved to the database, so it survives restarts.
breaker.offHint: -1 = transient failures never trip (deterministic failures still trip)

intent.title: Intent re-run
intent.where: This project · process-wide, one shared instance
intent.trigger: Layers above didn't absorb the failure: the worker ends with model_error, either because inner retries are exhausted or because the stream broke after output had already been delivered (replaying is unsafe then, so the whole intent must restart).
intent.skips: Quota exhaustion is already handled by profile rotation and is not re-run here. The re-run yields immediately if the task is paused, stopped or wrapping up, without spending backoff time.
intent.desc: Re-runs the entire intent from the beginning. It is the outermost layer, so each re-run multiplies the inner layers' counts again.
intent.offHint: -1 = no re-run; the intent is marked blocked directly

overrideDesc: Applies only to this profile and overrides the global defaults under "Retry & backoff". Leave a field blank to follow the global setting; a count of -1 turns that layer off; a set interval replaces exponential backoff with a fixed one. The circuit breaker and intent re-run are process-wide and can only be changed on the global page.
intro: A failed model call passes through five retry layers in order, from inside to outside: <hl>connect → empty response → same-provider safe window → polling circuit breaker → intent re-run</hl>. Outer layers are only tried once inner layers are exhausted, so the counts <hl>multiply</hl>. Maxing out every layer can burn dozens of requests on a single hiccup. Leaving everything blank keeps the current defaults, identical to the behavior before this page existed. The first three layers can be overridden per model profile.
saved: Saved and applied immediately (calls already in progress still use the old parameters)
